RTL8723BE (0xb723): signed legacy/HT20/40 station, coexistence scan/connect/special-packet/IPS, firmware RA, DM false alarms/RSSI/DIG/EDCCA/CCK-PD, short-preamble TX and TX-report matching are implemented.
